dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (I)
dialogues.text: "...Caressing the blade, singing I go, to cleave dragons and drink their blood. The divine light, like flowing lightning, like a frigid wave, threatens to smash the mountains..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (I)
dialogues.text: "...Beneath Mt. Tianheng, I slay tigers, the scaled beast I skewer amidst the Sea of Clouds... When I return crowned in success, we shall live at ease..."
